lines.text: It is over, and {winner} is the Showdown champion!
{winnerClub} lift the whole thing, and the long rivalry has its answer at last!
After {seasons} seasons there is a single name on the Showdown, and it is {winner}.
Champion, {winner}, by {margin}, and what a journey it has been!
It could have gone either way, and in the end it went to {winner}!
The final whistle has gone, and {winnerClub} are the champions of the Showdown.
{winner} wins it, {loser} gave everything, and the rivalry is richer for it.
Read it out loud, {winner}: Showdown champion. It sounds even better than you imagined.
{winnerPoints} to {loserPoints}, and the Showdown belongs to {winner}!
{loser} fought to the last, but the Showdown has found its champion in {winner}.
Raise the cup high, {winner}, because you earned every inch of it.
The open-top bus rolls out for {winnerClub}, and {loserClub} stand and applaud.
A Showdown for the ages, and the crown has finally found its head!
{winner} finishes {margin} clear, and the Showdown has its champion!
It took {seasons} seasons, a lot of nerve and a console that never got a rest, and {winner} is on top!
What a Showdown, and what a champion! {winner}, take a bow.
The crown is claimed, and the cabinet will never look the same again.
{loser} will be back, but today the Showdown belongs to {winner}.
There is a hush, then a roar, and {winner} is the Showdown champion!
Long nights, longer seasons, and at the end of them all, a champion.
Settled at last, the trophy has an owner, and it is not being put down.
Take the final whistle in, {loser}. It was a magnificent fight, and {winner} had the last word.
It is {winnerClub}! The Showdown is theirs, and the celebrations can begin!
From the very first season to the very last, {winner} kept pushing, and now the Showdown is theirs.
A famous win for {winnerClub} by {margin}, and {loserClub} can hold their heads high.
Champions of the Showdown, and nobody can take that away.
The curtain falls, the lights go up, and a lone figure stands at the top!
What a way to be remembered, {winner}: the manager who won the Showdown.
Say it again for the neighbors: we have a Showdown champion!
Finished on {winnerPoints}, and finished first. {winner}, the Showdown is yours.
{loser} pushed all the way to the end, but {winner} had the answer when it mattered.
They will tell this story for years, and the last line is {winner} lifting the Showdown!
After all this time, all those seasons, the Showdown finally has its champion!
Bring it home, and what a homecoming it is for the champions!
It ends here, with {winner} on top by {margin}, and a rivalry that will not soon be forgotten.
Hats off to {loser}, a worthy rival all the way, but the Showdown crown sits on {winner}.
There will be a party at {winnerClub}, and a thoughtful walk home for {loserClub}.
Final whistle, final word, and {winner} has the Showdown!
The big prize goes to {winner}, the big respect goes to {loser}, and everybody gets a story out of it.
Winner of the Showdown, {winner}, and the cabinet just got heavier!
A wonderful Showdown ends the only way it could, with a champion in the spotlight!
{winnerClub} take the Showdown by {margin}, and the whole rivalry stands to applaud.
Champions at last, {winnerClub}, and the road to get here was worth every mile.
Two clubs set out, {seasons} seasons passed, and {winnerClub} are the ones still smiling.
The ribbons are tied, the cup is polished, and {winner} will carry it with pride.
It is all over, {loser}, and what a fight you put up!
Never in doubt? Hardly. But {winner} got there, and that is all that matters!
It is done! The Showdown has a champion, and the champion has a grin!
The whole Showdown comes down to this picture: the cup lifted high, the handshake offered gracefully.
Decided at last, {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints}, and {winnerClub} are on top of the world!
We will remember the wins, the swings, the nerve, but most of all we will remember {winner} on top.
A champion crowned, a rival respected, and a Showdown that deserves its place in the story.
{winnerClub} have won the Showdown, and {loserClub} have earned a rematch.
Clear air, clear head, and a Showdown won by {margin}!
Long may it be told: {winner} won the Showdown, and {loser} made them earn every inch.
A last look at the table, {loser}, and a very big smile for {winner}.
The table says it, the cabinet says it, and the story will say it for years.
Who is the best manager of this Showdown? We have an answer, and it is {winner}!
Somewhere a banner is going up, and the name on it is the champion's.
When the dust settled, {winner} was still standing, and the Showdown was theirs.
Dugouts empty, console off, and {winner} still smiling at a Showdown won by {margin}.
Bravo. A Showdown this long needs a champion this good.
Season after season they went at it, and the cup has finally found a home!
Nobody is sitting down as the Showdown is settled at last!
Fine margins, fine football, and finally, a fine champion.
The sun sets on the Showdown, and it sets on {winnerClub} holding the trophy.
{loser}, you gave us a rivalry to remember. {winner}, you gave us a champion.
Look at the cabinet at {winnerClub}. There is a new centerpiece, and it is the Showdown!
Won by {winnerClub}, and the {winnerPoints} on the board tell the story.
They have played it all out, every season, every swing, and {winner} is the last one smiling!
A champion for the ages, {winner}, and a rival worthy of the name in {loser}.
It is {winner} by {margin}, and the Showdown can finally rest.
The Showdown trophy has a new home, and its address is {winnerClub}.
You wanted a champion, and here is the Showdown winner, arms raised, standing at the top!
What a story it has been, and {winner} has written the perfect last line.
The final table is in, and {winnerClub} sit at the top of it!
There it is, the moment you played every season for, and it is all yours.
{loserClub} came as rivals, they leave as friends, and {winnerClub} leave with the Showdown.
A Showdown won on nerve, on patience, and on {winnerPoints} well-earned points.
Think of the open-top bus, the ribbons, the cabinet, and say hello to {winner}, Showdown champion!
It is the end of the road, and {winner} has arrived at the top of it.
Champions are made in the long run, and {winner} just proved it over {seasons} seasons!
It will be a long time before anyone forgets this Showdown.
Handshake, hug, and then the cup for {winner}. That is the way the Showdown should end.
Won, and won well, and {winner} will remember how it felt!
Next time, {loser}, next time. For now, the Showdown belongs to {winnerClub}.
All that is left is the confetti, and it has been earned in full!
And there it is, the Showdown, raised high by {winner} for everyone to see!
After the chase, after the nerves, after the long seasons, the Showdown is {winner}'s.
Two rivals, a long road, and {winnerClub} at the end of it with the crown.
Finishing {margin} ahead is no accident, and {winner} has proved it where it counts.
The managers shake hands, the cup changes hands, and {winnerClub} change history.
A tip of the cap to {loserClub}, but the Showdown is on its way to {winnerClub}!
Cue the trumpets, because the Showdown has found its champion!
The final chapter closes with a champion crowned, and what a book it was.
Let the cabinet confirm it: the Showdown has been won.
The last page is turned, the last point is counted, and there is no more waiting.
Tears, laughter, a trophy, and a rivalry that stays friendly through it all!
That is the sound of a Showdown ending, and it sounds like a victory lap.
From the console glow to the cabinet glow, the story ends beautifully.
